title: Heteroskedasticity
text:
Homoskedasticity (MLR.5): Var(uᵢ | xᵢ) = σ²
Heteroskedasticity: Var(uᵢ | xᵢ) = σᵢ² - error variance changes with x
OLS estimates are still unbiased and consistent
BUT the usual standard errors are biased
so t-tests, F-tests and confidence intervals are invalid
Detect: residual plot, Breusch-Pagan test, White test
Fix: heteroskedasticity-robust (White) standard errors, or WLS
